tasks.title: Application entry point and offscreen smoke test
tasks.note:
FAILED
- B13: ran build/Examples/HandPaintingExample with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen (with HPQ_AUTO_QUIT=1, and also without it for 3 s then killed), then again with QT_FATAL_WARNINGS=1 -> there is no crash, and the window stays alive in the event loop. The auto-quit exit code is 0, and the ctest suite passes 4/4. Stderr does show Qt warnings, though: `qt.qpa.fonts: Populating font family aliases took 55 ms. Replace uses of missing font family "Sans Serif" with one that exists to avoid this cost.` and `This plugin does not support propagateSizeHints()`. With QT_FATAL_WARNINGS=1 the app aborts at the first of these, with exit 134. -> the spec expects no crash and no Qt warning. The in-process unit test counts 0 warnings, but a real run prints these two messages. The "Sans Serif" one probably comes from the .ui font or the default font; the propagateSizeHints one comes from the offscreen plugin and may be unavoidable.
Evidence: specs/example-app/real-testing/T7/
tasks.review:
APPROVED
- Startup.MainWindowShowsAndRunsEventLoopWithoutWarning (Examples/tests/StartupTest.cpp): counts warnings, creates and shows MainWindow, checks isVisible() inside the event loop, expects 0 warnings. It ignores only messages containing "propagateSizeHints".
- ctest HandPaintingExampleRunsOffscreen (Examples/CMakeLists.txt): runs HandPaintingExample with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen and HPQ_AUTO_QUIT=1, expects exit code 0. main.cpp reads that variable.

Verification notes (independent):
- The full test command passes, 4 of 4 tests.
- Running the app offscreen now prints only "This plugin does not support propagateSizeHints()". The "Sans Serif" warning is gone. The exit code is 0.
- I built a bare QWidget + QVBoxLayout + QLabel (no application code) against Qt 6.8.3 and ran it offscreen. It prints the same propagateSizeHints message and exits with 0. It also printed the "Sans Serif" alias warning, because it does not call applyDefaultFont(). So the developer's claim is real: the remaining warning comes from the offscreen plugin, not from the application.
- With QT_FATAL_WARNINGS=1 the app aborts with exit 134 on that one message. The bare widget would abort the same way.
- I accept the remaining warning for B13. The app cannot avoid it without suppressing messages in production code, which would be worse. The test filter is narrow: every other warning, critical or fatal message is still counted.
tasks.real_testing:
PASSED
- B13: Rebuilt the app and ran HandPaintingExample offscreen with HPQ_AUTO_QUIT=1 three times, then with no auto-quit for 4 s -> exit 0 each time, no crash, window shows and event loop runs (process still alive after 4 s without auto-quit). The "Sans Serif" font alias warning is gone. The only output is the single line "This plugin does not support propagateSizeHints()". All 4 ctest tests pass offscreen.
- B13 (remaining warning): Built a bare QWidget + QVBoxLayout + QLabel program with no app code (specs/example-app/real-testing/T7/bare/) and ran it offscreen under Qt 6.8.3 -> it prints the same propagateSizeHints() line (plus the "Sans Serif" alias message that the app's Helvetica font avoids). So the remaining line comes from the offscreen plugin and any shown layout triggers it; the app cannot control it. I did not take a screenshot, since the spec only asks for offscreen output.
Judgement call: read literally, B13 says "without Qt warning" and this one plugin line does appear on stderr. I accepted it as a plugin artefact rather than an app fault. If you want a strictly empty run, that would need a message-handler filter, which is your decision.
Evidence: specs/example-app/real-testing/T7/
